_comment: The scene set of the second evaluation round, closed by the user on 2026-09-02 after
the phase-0 probe. This file replaces recon-manifest.json as the source of scenes for
the campaign; the recon manifest stays as the record of the FIRST round and must not
be edited, or last round's numbers stop being reproducible.
python tools/campaign.py --manifest tools/ewaluacja-campaign.json configs
Six cells, three sizes x two levels of the lit-voxel share. The share is not an
absolute threshold: no large scene reaches 20 %, because the share falls with scene
size, so within each size class the set takes the highest and the lowest candidate.
The numbers below are from the 128^3 probe and go into the scene table of chapter 5:
Cornell Box  63.9 %   2 m      32 tris       accept 99.9 %
Bedroom      13.1 %   7 m      1 499 344     accept 69.6 %
Staircase    31.0 %  10 m      262 508       accept 85.3 %
Veach Ajar    6.6 %  17 m      382 628       accept 77.1 % (128^3)
'accept' is the guided-sample acceptance (GuideAcceptance view): the share of guided
samples that survive the gate. It is the criterion for whether the technique has
anything to steer at all, and it RISES with grid resolution - which is why the two
large scenes carry a grid ladder that starts where their guide comes alive.
Sun Temple is NOT in the set: its acceptance is 0.0 % at every rung below 256^3, and the
whole grid ladder moves its FLIP by 2.4 % (0.10093-0.10337 from 32^3 to 512^3), which
is inside the tie tolerance. The grid is inert on a 271 m scene even where the guide
finally accepts samples. It is described in the chapter as the documented negative case.
'exposure', 'contrast' and 'saturation' are the tone settings the user authored in the
GUI and froze on 2026-09-02. They decide what the image looks like and therefore what
every FLIP number means; they are not free parameters.
'bounces: 1' is the ENGINE's spelling, counting bounces after the shading point. In
the thesis' convention that is two bounces. Do not renumber it here.

scenes._note: 63.9 % lit at 128^3, acceptance 99.9 % - the near-uniform guide, where the gain is expected to vanish. 256^3 and 512^3 are excluded: 222 587 and 468 881 lit voxels against a 131 072 compaction buffer, so those rungs measure the cap.

scenes._class: mała / irradiancja w małej części sceny
scenes._note: 13.1 % lit at 128^3, acceptance 69.6 %. 1.5 M triangles - the densest small scene. 512^3 is admissible here (49 911 lit voxels, under the 131 072 cap) unlike on Cornell Box and Staircase.
31.0 % lit at 128^3, acceptance 85.3 %. 512^3 excluded: 186 427 lit voxels past the 131 072 cap.

scenes._class: średnia / irradiancja w małej części sceny
scenes._note: 6.6 % lit at 128^3, acceptance 64.6 % at 64^3 and 77.1 % at 128^3. Light through a door slit; the strongest guided win of the first round (145 %).

scenes._class: duża / irradiancja w większości sceny (w klasie)
scenes._note: 2.3 % lit at 128^3. The ladder starts at 128^3 because acceptance is 0.2 % at 32^3 and 0.1 % at 64^3 - below that the guide is dead and the rung would measure path tracing plus the chain's cost. 3.2 % at 128^3, 17.7 % at 256^3, 25.4 % at 512^3. 9.9 M triangles, 23 ms/frame.

scenes._class: poza zbiorem - komórka diagnostyczna dla drabiny siatki
scenes._note: NOT one of the six. Acceptance 0.0 / 0.0 / 0.1 / 2.9 / 20.4 % at 32 / 64 / 128 / 256 / 512^3 and 139 ms/frame at 512^3 - the case where the guide only comes alive at a rung nobody can afford. Measured here so the chapter can say what the grid does on a scene of 271 m rather than assert it.

scenes._class: duża / irradiancja w małej części sceny
scenes._note: 0.6 % lit at 128^3 - the smallest guide support in the set (49 lit voxels at 128^3). Acceptance 42.1 / 26.4 / 25.3 / 32.9 % at 32 / 64 / 256 / 512^3, so the guide is alive at every rung; 128^3 was censused (0.6 % lit) but its acceptance was not measured.
